author: Anas
title: Hiring artist for ongoing paid comics
content:
Looking for an artist for ongoing comic work.

Style reference: something close to https://www.youtube.com/@ReelerReads/shortscomics
(simple, bold-outline, expressive, doesn't need to be super detailed)

I write the script, you draw a short comic based on it. Starting with 5 comics, paid per comic, budget-friendly rate, open to your quote.

To prove you're a real person and not a bot: reply with your favorite comic panel you've drawn AND the word "pixel" somewhere in your reply. Auto-replies without both get ignored.

DM your rate after that.

#commissionsopen #artistsopentowork #cartoonart #comic #comics
Contact: DM @nas2litt
budget: paid per comic, budget-friendly, open to quote
